reviews.text: Dear Doctor!
They were very kind and the prices were reasonable! I recommend them to everyone!
We have gained experience in the case of reptiles.5-s.

For about 13 years, my dog ​​with food allergies and heart disease was treated by Dr. Péter Csendes, whom Maszatka trusted completely, and he performed all the tests without a word. He didn't grumble or complain (he did it with other doctors). Today, in Dr. Péter Csendes's absence, Dr. Balázs Szűcs put my seriously ill dog to sleep with the greatest respect, humanely, and compassionately. I thank both of them and the lovely assistants for their work and wish them continued successful healing.
Super kind and precise and I can only recommend it to everyone, thank you!

Dr. Péter Csendes is a very good veterinarian. I try to take my animals to him. My older cats had wounds on their heads before and he immediately told me that they might have a chicken allergy. It went away quickly for them and over time they were able to reintroduce chicken. He is always very patient and helpful♡
The prices are also kept quite low compared to other expensive clinics. In many ways, it is worth traveling to them from another district. There are no deductions, no extra costs, they try to get a favorable deal for the owner:).
The doctors and assistants are very conscientious and helpful. Everything can be discussed, it's not about money.
I'm just bringing my puppy here.
They are very kind and fast.

Both of them are great, I can only recommend them! They did everything for our cat Azur. Hats off to them, even in terms of delivery! The prices are good too! Thanks to them for the fast, flexible, kind service!
Good doctors and smiling dogs
They are very kind, pet-friendly. You can also pay by credit card.

Fast, precise, attentive.
They can also handle non-animal friendly dogs well. They handle the whole situation well. I can only recommend them!

We will definitely be coming here from now on!
They are professional, super nice, they are not about money, and it is obvious that they love animals! I can always trust my dog ​​to the hands of Dr. Balázs Szűcs and Natália Bogdán🥰
I wish all veterinarians were like this!
Kind, helpful team. Great, conscientious doctors. Cute kitty in the office🤩 …
The best doctor is here, who does not treat animals as pieces but does his job with spiritual knowledge... I can only recommend Dr. Péter Csendes to everyone...
The best!
Competent, kind, patient doctors and assistants. I highly recommend them for both dogs and cats.
Dr. Eszter Kók and Natália Bogdán calmed down my terribly stressed dachshund while he was having his nails trimmed. I am very grateful to them!
All of our animals are cared for with great expertise, no matter what problem we have. Everyone who works here is kind, friendly, and has a lot of love for the animals.
